# Pulse 1.0.391 🚀

## 🎮 Game Hub
- ⚙️ Game Hub's settings are now in Boxshelf's Settings, in a Game Hub section: look, library, icons, start page, covers, box style, case style, in-game menu, access and setup.
- 🖼️ The back of a box shows the game's own Steam screenshots (up to four) when the covers were looked for.
- 🎚️ The spine takes the colour of the game's cover.
- 🧹 The mix uses the Steam covers; the Xbox and console frames are no longer dealt to every game.
- 🏷️ The app icon is no longer drawn on the cover; it stays beside the title.
- 🎬 The launch slide is about 2/5 of its old length.

🔧 Build: the Game Hub settings bridge (keys read and written from Boxshelf) and the cover search and in-game menu actions from Settings.
